conceptual_change: Introduce a mean-reversion trigger by monitoring the distance from the 20-period VWAP as an indicator of localized price exhaustion during statistical arbitrage entry phases.
rationale: The selected strategy relies on OU process residuals. By adding a VWAP distance filter, we can ensure that mean-reversion trades are triggered primarily when the price has extended significantly from the volume-weighted average, confirming exhaustion in the underlying instrument before executing the residual-based signal.
